value.answer: Honestly there's no agreed winner, but I'd go with the 2026 Kia Carnival Hybrid. The Weekly Driver, the newest review I found (5 days old), calls it the best overall for most families: 32 mpg combined vs the Sienna's 36, 44 more cubic feet of cargo space, and a 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. Edmunds ties it with the Sienna at 7.8/10. U.S. News rates the Odyssey highest at 9.3 and it drives most like a car, but a rearview camera recall on the Odyssey has been reported, so look into that before you buy one. If mpg matters most, get the Sienna.
